Interface Item

All Known Subinterfaces:
Equipable
All Known Implementing Classes:
Armor, Crossbow, HealthPotion, Potion, PowerfulPotion, Shield, SpeedPotion, Sword
public interface Item
Represents a generic item that can be used or equipped by a PlayerCharacter.

Items may apply effects to the player (such as modifying stats, providing bonuses, or granting temporary abilities). Some items may also be unequipped to remove their effects.

    • canBeEquipped

      default boolean canBeEquipped(PlayerCharacter player)
      Determines whether the given player can equip this item. By default, all player types can equip any item. Implementations may override this method to restrict equipment based on class type (e.g. only Warriors can equip heavy armor).
      Parameters:
      player - the player attempting to equip the item.
      Returns:
      true if the item can be equipped, false otherwise.

    • getEquipFailReason

      default String getEquipFailReason(PlayerCharacter player)
      Returns the reason why the given player cannot equip this item. This method is used when canBeEquipped(PlayerCharacter) returns false. By default, it returns null, meaning no specific failure message is provided. Implementations may override this method to supply detailed explanations (e.g. "Only mages can equip magical staffs").
      Parameters:
      player - the player who attempted to equip the item.
      Returns:
      a string describing the reason for the failed equip attempt, or an empty string ("") if no message is defined.
